Lab Summary

Advanced Intelligence Lab at Samsung Research America is working towards a vision of a world-class voice assistant that provides a unified AI experience across multiple devices (Galaxy Smartphones, Galaxy Watch & Smart home appliances like TVs, Family Hub, IoT devices etc.) with deep integration and building Agentic AI assisted solutions.

We work on applied research, innovative products, services, and experiences to delight our users by promoting advanced artificial intelligence technology to make best user experience with Bixby AI assistant to be intuitive, faster, seamless, more powerful, and multi-dimensional across different product domains/categories. Our goal is to improve user’s lifestyles through AI and related advanced technologies

Position Summary

Bixby is an intelligent personal assistant which is only available as a built-in application on Samsung flagship devices and wearables. This is an advance intelligent system backed by an Agentic AI framework. This application uses Natural Language Understand users’ intentions and provide smart assistance by answering the questions and performing actions for users. Based on users intent Bixby can perform perform tasks on these devices, including but not limited to making phone calls, sending text messages, setting up meetings, opening apps, setting alarms and timers, getting directions, answering general questions, providing information about restaurants and other businesses, etc.

Samsung Bixby team is seeking talented and self-driven software engineering interns to join our applied research on Agentic AI on-device solutions. As an intern you will work closely with our team of engineers to develop and maintain software products, learn about the latest technologies and industry trends, and gain valuable experience in a fast-paced and dynamic work environment and build next generation Agentic AI services that influence the evolution of smart assistant solutions across our flagship devices.

Position Responsibilities



- Deeply involve in devolving agents and tools used by Bixby agentic framework
- Develop Intelligent systems that use the LLM backed agentic framework to address expectation of Bixby as a next generation smart assistant
- Design and implement algorithms to develop hybrid reasoning models that integrate multiple approaches and derive actionable insights
- Design and implement advanced web intelligence features, encompassing data extraction, semantic analysis, and adaptive learning algorithms, to create a knowledge-driven answer engine
- Develop and fine-tune hybrid models with novel algorithms for on-device compilations and edge computations
- Set up processes to monitor and continually improve efficiency and performance of models by different methods of tuning
- Write high-quality production code as you build and maintain robust, scalable machine learning systems
- Program primarily in Python and / or Java using efficient algorithms and software design patterns
- Participate in new product concepts and create proof-of-concept prototypes
- Function as an integral part of a larger team and collaborate and communicate effectively

Required Skills



- Currently pursuing a BS, MS, or PhD Computer Science or equivalent field with knowledge around NLP, ML, AI, Agentic framework
- Experience and proficiency in software development in any language
- Experience with deep learning architectures such as LSTMs, Transformers, Tree-LSTMs, Graph Neural Networks, etc.
- Knowledge of advanced ML techniques for improving recommendation accuracy and scalability based on content-based filtering methodologies
- Experience with deep learning frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, JAX and libraries like Hugging Face transformers, Deep Graph Library, DGL-KE, etc. with specific requirements for Android devices
- Hands on experience with Web applications/REST API services development in a professional environment
- Strong knowledge of design patterns and scalable architecture
- Strong understanding of computer science fundamentals such as algorithms, data structures and run-time analysis
- Ability to create self-contained, reusable, and testable modules and components
- Experience working in a complex large codebase and or in an open-source project
- Extensive experience with software prototyping or designing experimental software
- Analytical and problem-solving skills for design, creation, and testing of custom software

This position is open to candidates who are legally authorized to work in the United States.

Our total rewards programs are designed to motivate and engage exceptional talent. The hourly pay rate range for roles at this level is listed below, but may be higher or lower in other states due to geographic differentials in the labor market. Within the hourly pay rate range, individual rates depend on a number of factors—including the role’s function and location as well as the individual’s knowledge, skills, experience, education and training. This is part of our comprehensive compensation package with annual bonus eligibility and generous benefits to help you live life well.

$36—$63 USD

Essential Job Functions

This position will be performed in an office setting. The position will require the incumbent to sit and stand at a desk, communicate in person and by telephone, and frequently operate standard office equipment, such as telephones and computers.

role: Data Science & Software Engineering Intern: Winter/Spring 2027 (Part-Time)
jd:
Data Science & Software Engineering Intern — Winter/Spring 2027 (Part-Time)
HOA Simplified · La Jolla, San Diego, CA (in person) · Part-time, 20 hrs/week · Rolling start from now through Summer 2027 · For academic credit
We build software, data systems and AI agents that run a real business with a small team. This is a part-time, in-office internship for college students near La Jolla who want to ship things people actually use.About the role
We operate and grow community association (HOA) management businesses in California. That sounds unglamorous, and that's the point: it's an industry that still runs on PDFs, spreadsheets and phone calls, which means a small team with good software has a real edge.
We've built our own stack to get that edge: a Postgres data platform (Supabase) with hundreds of tables covering every community we manage, internal web apps on Vercel that staff use every day, n8n automations, Slack bots, and AI agents built on the Claude and Gemini APIs. We also work in CINC, HubSpot, RingCentral and Google Workspace. Most of what we build is written with AI coding tools like Claude Code, and we expect you to use them too.
As an intern, you'll be handed real operational problems, not a sandbox project. You'll work directly with the people who built these systems, and the more initiative you show, the more you'll own.What you'll work on
These are projects that are live or underway right now. You'll contribute to several of them, and take ownership of a well-scoped piece of one.

- AI document extraction. When we take over a new community, the prior manager hands us years of ledgers, invoices and statements in no consistent format. We're building pipelines that read those files and pull out structured data, such as who the community's active vendors are and how recently they were paid. You'll help test extraction on messy real-world PDFs, measure accuracy, and fix what breaks.
- Internal tools that replace software we'd otherwise buy. We're building a vendor bidding (RFP) portal where contractors submit bids by link or email, and staff-facing views for work orders and maintenance. You'll help build features, test them with the staff who use them, and ship fixes.
- Automations and bots. n8n workflows and Slack bots that move data between our systems and flag what needs attention, like a bot that summarizes open maintenance work orders for the team. You'll build new ones and make existing ones more reliable.
- Data quality and dashboards. Some of our leadership metrics are still assembled by hand. You'll help clean and validate data in our Postgres platform and HubSpot, and turn it into live dashboards people make decisions from.
- Growth and acquisition research. We maintain a database of California HOA management companies and communities. You'll help gather, verify and score company and contact data, and help automate the parts that are still manual.
- Documentation. Writing down how each workflow and tool works, so the next person can run it without asking you.What the internship looks like

- First 2–3 weeks: learn the systems. Get access to the tools, read-only to start. Shadow how staff actually work, and fix a few small, real issues so you learn the codebase and the data.
- Weeks 3–8: contribute. Take tasks across two or three of the projects above. Propose at least one improvement of your own and build a small working version to test it.
- Remaining months: own something. Take one well-defined project from scoping to a working version staff use, with documentation. Present what you built, what worked, and what you'd do next.
Everything that touches live data or staff workflows gets reviewed before it goes to production. You'll have room to experiment, with guardrails that keep real communities' records safe.Who we're looking for
We care more about how you think than what you've already learned. You'll fit well if you are:

- A builder who questions the task. You ask whether there's a better way to do something, then test your idea instead of waiting for permission.
- Self-directed. You can work through ambiguity with light supervision, and you know when to ask for help instead of spinning.
- Comfortable with technology. Some experience with Python, SQL, JavaScript/TypeScript, automation tools or AI APIs is a plus. Coursework and personal projects count. Resourcefulness counts more.
- Careful with details. Our data describes real people's homes and money. Getting it right matters.
- A clear communicator. You can explain what you built and why to someone who isn't technical.
- Genuinely curious about AI, automation, and how businesses actually run.
You don't need to meet every point to apply. Majors in computer science, data science, engineering, math, economics or anything else are welcome.What you'll get, honestly

- Shipped work you can point to. Real tools and workflows staff use, plus a write-up you can show in interviews.
- Production experience with applied AI. Building with LLM APIs and AI coding tools against messy real data, not toy datasets.
- A modern stack: Postgres/Supabase, Vercel, n8n, HubSpot, GitHub, and the Claude and Gemini APIs.
- Direct access to the founder and the builders. You'll see how decisions get made at a small, growing company.
- A reference from people who watched you work, and a path to a summer or post-graduation role for strong performers.
- Flexible scheduling around your classes and exams.
What to expect: this is a small team, so structure is light and priorities shift. Some of the work is unglamorous, like cleaning data and verifying records. That's also where you learn how the business really works, and it's often where the best automation ideas come from.
To apply, submit through LinkedIn or Handshake and email your resume and cover letter directly to the founder at david@alliedlegacypartners.com with the subject line:
ALP Winter/Spring Tech Intern: {Full Name}, {School}
In your cover letter, briefly cover:

- Why this internship, and how it fits your career goals.
- Relevant experience: coursework, jobs, projects, or things you've built on your own. A link to a GitHub repo, demo or notebook is welcome but not required.
- A time you found a creative or unconventional solution to a problem, or built something that didn't exist yet.
- How you work in unstructured situations with minimal oversight: how you stay motivated and hold yourself accountable.
- Your earliest start date, and confirmation that you can commit 20 hours/week in person in La Jolla.
Every application is read by the founder. Nothing is screened out automatically.
All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.
